report_scope: preregistered same-image dual-pixel-budget counterfactual on frozen ADE20K samples

primary_metric.metric: unweighted per-sample paired difference (the official cv_bench_accuracy is undefined inside the single ADE20K source)
primary_metric.rule: the only decision input; the official cv_bench_accuracy is undefined inside the single ADE20K source

checks: exactly 100 unique sample_ids in the separated manifest and each of the four arm files; all five id sets identical
authoritative processor dry run: resolved, 0 rejected / replaced / unresolved, 100 accepted
every low record G <= 512 and every high record G > 512
every record G equals the authoritative per-sample dry-run measurement
every record arm / pixel_budget_label / min_pixels / max_pixels matches its file
every record K=96 / region_grid=3 / local_candidate_cap=16 / B1 cutpoint / greedy / max_new_tokens=16
prompt records carry the frozen checkpoint / Wv / Wv scale hashes; no-prompt records carry none
every record record_sha256 re-verifies; no duplicate ids
same-image low/high pairing with distinct input grids
integer and prompt arms share the identical image_grid_thw and full_llm_visual_tokens at every sample / pixel budget
config design / sample count / gate threshold match
config manifest and reserve SHA256 pins re-verified on disk
config low / high processor pixel budgets match
config frozen_forward (B1 cutpoint, K=96, grid=3, cap=16, BF16, SDPA, greedy, max_new_tokens=16, seed 20261003) matches
seed-20261003 checkpoint / Wv / Wv scale SHA256 re-verified on disk
config arms and bootstrap / decision contract match
gate report config SHA256 matches the preregistered config

primary_comparison.metric: unweighted per-sample paired difference (the official cv_bench_accuracy is undefined inside the single ADE20K source)
primary_comparison.note: the official score(...)["cv_bench_accuracy"] is undefined inside the single ADE20K source and is never computed

decision.reason: 95% stratified paired bootstrap CI lower bound -0.200000 <= 0.0 (mean_i [ (Prompt_correct - Integer_correct)_high - (Prompt_correct - Integer_correct)_low ])

limitations: Software Selector bridge only; no FPGA, latency or acceleration claim is made.
The official score(...)["cv_bench_accuracy"] is undefined inside the single ADE20K source; only the preregistered unweighted paired difference is computed.
Pointing / grounding / nDCG / retained-mass are never reported.
The four GPU arm files were produced with a single A6000 BF16/SDPA forward; the counterfactual only varies the processor pixel budget of the same frozen image.
